ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels occupying the central and proximal regions, contrasted with 30% high-intensity cream/white pixels localized on the distal fluke tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous mass across the central fluke body. Distal high-intensity patches situated on the terminal ends of both lobes. Significant mid-intensity mottling (grey/brown) occurs at the transition zones between the dark central area and light distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 135 degrees; vertical bounding-box depth is minimal relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-amplitude, low-frequency jagged peaks. Notable deep indentations visible on the mid-sections of both lobes, creating a 'sawtooth' profile against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a sharp upward convexity, tapering to acute, narrow tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular spots (pixel clusters) visible on the lower-left ventral surface near the water line.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity distal patches on both lobes, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of brownish-red biological growth or debris (likely kelp or whale lice) attached to the terminal tip of the left lobe; heavy scarring/rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of deep, jagged 'U' shaped gouges on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration.
